summary: Server one-frame request that an entity is being thrown (seen alive in item-throw and shove-throw). Drained by esv::thrown::ThrowAnimationSystem::ProcessThrownRequests (EoCServer.dll+0x3D3D50), which copies +0xC, +0x10 and +0x18 into eoc::thrown::IsThrownComponent (layouts\alive\eoc.thrown.IsThrownComponent.json: float, byte, EntityHandle) and uses +0..+0xC in the rotation it writes to the frame data; also read by improvised_weapon::PickUpSystem and invisibility::ChangesSystem::ProcessItemAnimationStateChanges.

fields.name: Displacement
fields.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0x7F2D80 esv::ProjectileInitializationSystem::InitializeProjectileThrown (bg3.exe twin 0x2E8EC40) adds the request and writes +0..+8 = InitializationInfo.TargetPosition (+0x10) - StartPosition (+4) (Script Extender's esv::projectile::InitializationData layout): the vector from the throw's start to its target, not normalised (live (17.6,-1.36,5)). ProcessThrownRequests EoCServer.dll+0x3D3D50 uses its length against the throw-param thresholds to choose the number of spins and its x/z direction for the yaw.

fields.name: Duration
fields.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0x7F2D80 InitializeProjectileThrown writes +0xC = eoc::PathMover::SampleDuration(projectile +0x238, 1.0): the flight time of the projectile path. ProcessThrownRequests EoCServer.dll+0x3D3D50 skips the request when it is ~0, copies it into eoc::thrown::IsThrownComponent +0 and ThrownAnimationRequestOneFrameComponent +0, and divides spins*2*pi by it to get the angular velocity. Live 0.287 .. 1.313.

fields.name: SpellAnimationType
fields.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0x7F2D80 InitializeProjectileThrown writes +0x10 = byte +0x19 of the throw's eoc::SpellPrototype, which Script Extender's stats::SpellPrototype names SpellAnimationType (gatekit symbols layout: +0x019 uint8_t SpellAnimationType). Copied to IsThrownComponent +4 and ThrownAnimationRequestOneFrameComponent +4. Live 3.

fields.name: Caster

fields.name: ThrownObject
fields.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0x7F2D80 InitializeProjectileThrown writes +0x20 = InitializationInfo +0x2B0, the entity the function checks for character/item ('Thrown object type is not supported' otherwise) and matches against split stacks - Script Extender's InitializationData.ThrownObject.
